on_five_year_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LE_country_has_legend = yes }
		DA_LE_five_year_pulse = yes
	}
}

# ROOT = province, FROM = previous owner: a fight does not survive a change of owner
on_province_owner_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged }
		DA_LE_stop_fight = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_open }
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_open
	}
}
